Container.Name: experiment-undead-server
Container.Overview: Dedicated server for Fenlight, a co-op wave survival shooter. Up to 8 players. Use tag "latest" for releases or "edge" for the newest main build.

Config.Name: Game port
Config.Description: UDP port players connect to. Forward it on your router for players outside your network.

Config.Name: Server browser port
Config.Description: UDP port the in-game server browser asks for the name and player count. Always the game port + 1000. Forward it next to the game port.

Config.Name: Server name
Config.Description: The name players see in the server browser. Up to 32 letters.
